items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: he said, I'm going to get you up in that area... sure enough, he did come and he gave me a call... Dorsey--had several dates and we played around

ctx.x: He's a lovable person; I know him very well. The original hip cat.
As I said, I was just tickled over Roy and we would play and were doing pretty good, and a young man came to town--did you ever know a Phil Dorsey?
